mapper.sql: id, user_id, billing_request_id, trace_id, request_fingerprint, ability_code, requested_microcredits, minimum_microcredits, freeze_id, reserved_microcredits, intended_action, intended_microcredits, settled_microcredits, llm_invocation_id, input_rate_snapshot, output_rate_snapshot, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, usage_source, charged_microcredits, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, provider_started_at, lease_owner, lease_until, last_error, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_settlement_command ( user_id, billing_request_id, trace_id, request_fingerprint, ability_code, requested_microcredits, minimum_microcredits, freeze_id, reserved_microcredits, intended_action, intended_microcredits, settled_microcredits, llm_invocation_id, input_rate_snapshot, output_rate_snapshot, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, usage_source, charged_microcredits, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, provider_started_at, lease_owner, lease_until, last_error, version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{billingRequestId}, #{traceId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{abilityCode}, #{requestedMicrocredits}, #{minimumMicrocredits}, #{freezeId}, #{reservedMicrocredits}, #{intendedAction}, #{intendedMicrocredits}, #{settledMicrocredits}, #{llmInvocationId}, #{inputRateSnapshot}, #{outputRateSnapshot}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{usageSource}, #{chargedMicrocredits}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), #{providerStartedAt}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntil}, #{lastError}, #{version}, NOW(3), NOW(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quota_settlement_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND billing_request_id = #{billingRequestId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM quota_settlement_command WHERE freeze_id = #{freezeId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET freeze_id = #{freezeId}, reserved_microcredits = #{reservedMicrocredits}, state = 'RESERVED', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'RESERVE_PENDING'

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET state = 'RESERVE_FAILED', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'RESERVE_PENDING'

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET state = 'PROVIDER_STARTED', provider_started_at = NOW(3), next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{manualReviewMinutes} MINUTE), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'RESERVED'

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET intended_action = #{intent}, intended_microcredits = #{intendedMicrocredits}, llm_invocation_id = #{llmInvocationId}, input_rate_snapshot = #{inputRateSnapshot}, output_rate_snapshot = #{outputRateSnapshot}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, usage_source = #{usageSource}, charged_microcredits = #{chargedMicrocredits}, state = 'APPLY_PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND (state = 'PROVIDER_STARTED' OR (state = 'RESERVED' AND #{intent} = 'RELEASE'))

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET state = #{terminalState}, settled_microcredits = #{settledMicrocredits}, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state = 'APPLY_PENDING'

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET state = 'CONFLICT', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'RELEASED', 'RESERVE_FAILED', 'CONFLICT')

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET state = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state IN ('RESERVE_PENDING', 'PROVIDER_STARTED', 'APPLY_PENDING')

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND state IN ('RESERVE_PENDING', 'APPLY_PENDING')

UPDATE quota_settlement_command SET lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE state IN ('RESERVE_PENDING', 'RESERVED', 'PROVIDER_STARTED', 'APPLY_PENDING') AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchLimit}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quota_settlement_command WHERE lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} ORDER BY id ASC
